Three of the 11 searchable contracts have arbitration clauses: Acme_MSA.pdf (§14.2), Brightline_SOW.docx (§9), and Northwind_NDA.pdf (§11). The other eight don't mention arbitration.

I couldn't check Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf. It's a scanned image with no extractable text, so it needs OCR or a manual read before you can rule it out.
